data.name: Pickup Point Chaos
data.detailed_description:
Pickup Point Chaos is a first-person parcel pickup point management simulator.

Receive a constant flow of packages, scan them to generate pickup codes, sort them onto the shelves, and find the right parcel before your customers lose patience. As packages pile up and the line gets longer, can you keep your pickup point under control?

  • Receive, Scan, Organize

Packages of all shapes and sizes arrive at your pickup point in batches every day.

Scan each package, generate its pickup code, and place it on the shelves according to its number and location. Make good use of your limited storage space and leave room for the next delivery—the better organized you are, the easier it will be to find each parcel later.

  • Find the Right Parcel—Fast

Customers will arrive at the counter to collect their packages.

Check their pickup information, locate the correct parcel among shelves packed with boxes, and complete the handover as quickly as possible. Your speed, accuracy, and customer waiting times will all affect customer satisfaction and your results for the day.

  • Carry More, Risk More

You can carry several packages at once by stacking them in your arms.

Place the larger boxes at the bottom and the smaller ones on top, then move carefully. Sudden stops, sharp turns, and sprinting will make the entire stack wobble. Stack them too high or move too quickly, and the boxes on top may come crashing down.

  • Handle Special Packages with Care

Regular packages are only the beginning. You will also handle fragile, flammable, refrigerated, frozen, high-value, and liquid-filled packages, each requiring a different approach.

Fragile items cannot withstand a fall, refrigerated and frozen packages cannot be left out for too long, and dangerous packages may even explode after a heavy impact.

One careless move could cost you more than a single parcel.

  • Get Through a Chaotic Day

New packages arrive in batches while the line of waiting customers continues to grow. You will need to switch quickly between receiving, scanning, organizing, finding, and handing over parcels while deciding what to deal with first.

At the end of the day, your completed orders, earnings, customer satisfaction, and damaged packages will determine your final rating.

Scan. Shelve. Find. Deliver.

And try not to blow up the pickup point.
